title: Glacier lagoon & Diamond Beach
summary: Sunlit ice is a highlight trap: the sparkle you came for is the first thing to clip.
why: Ice specular highlights sit stops above everything else. Protect them and the scene reads true; blow them and the diamonds turn to white plastic. On black sand the metering trap doubles.

steps.text: Shoot RAW — ice blues live in the recovered highlights

pitfalls: A polarizer kills the ice sparkle along with the glare — rotate it half-strength, or take it off for Diamond Beach.
levelUp: Telephoto the lagoon: 200mm stacks bergs against the glacier face — compression turns scatter into a wall of ice.
